mapper.sql: a.id, a.poem_id, a.provider, a.prompt, a.lyrics, a.status, a.error, a.track_id, a.create_time, a.finish_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_music a WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT , s.url AS audio_url, s.name AS track_name, s.duration FROM ai_music a LEFT JOIN song s ON s.id = a.track_id JOIN poem m ON m.id = a.poem_id WHERE a.poem_id = #{poemId} AND a.status = 'done' ORDER BY a.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_music (poem_id, provider, prompt, lyrics, status, create_time) VALUES (#{poemId}, #{provider}, #{prompt}, #{lyrics}, #{status}, NOW())
